description: The Reliability Engineer behavior accepted on 2026-08-20 is the minimum permitted production quality. Future versions may improve it, but may not regress below it.
floorNote: This manifest is NOT self-protecting and deliberately is not in its own protectedPaths - that would deadlock every legitimate ratchet behind a live qualification run. The irreducible minimum lives in code at scripts/reliability-baseline-floor.mjs and is re-asserted from independent literals in src/test/reliabilityBaselineRatchet.test.ts, which runs inside the required 'Unit tests' check. This manifest may only be ratcheted against that floor: more protected paths, stricter thresholds, more cases, more dimensions, more governed database objects. Golden cases are pinned by CONTENT fingerprint, not by id - the id is not the trap.

tierPolicy.core: Reachable from a core Reliability Engineer entrypoint. A change requires a machine-written qualification report from a verified CI run PLUS a named human SME approval sidecar carrying that report's sha256.
tierPolicy.prompt-surface: Carries Reliability Engineer instruction text or deterministic engineering numbers into an answer, but is NOT exercised by the qualification harness. Demanding a live A/B here would be theatre, so a change requires a named human SME approval sidecar naming the exact files and their current blob shas. Stated as a bounded guarantee in docs/reliability-engineer-baseline.md.

trust_rank, permitted_claims and redistributable — the claim-type and public-redistribution gate
the claim-type enumeration the retrieval gate is written against

modelGovernance.why: The floor pins FILES. The model that answers comes from deployed environment variables (LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, TIER_*, MODEL_*), so the reasoning model behind a safety-critical Reliability Engineer can be changed with no repo diff, no pull request and no review, and every file-hash gate still passes. Transport SHOULD be swappable - that is a correct abstraction and buildProviderChain implements it. Model identity should not be.
modelGovernance.transport: unpinned by design - any OpenAI-compatible gateway is legitimate
modelGovernance.modelIdentity: allowlisted below; anything else is unqualified
modelGovernance.enforcement: scripts/check-deployed-model.mjs. Advisory until reference-outputs.json exists, blocking afterwards - a gate that refuses every model before any model can be qualified is theatre.
